$mountedComment: 🖼️ `mounted` names the CONDITION React mounts that chip's `Pane` under, not a claim that every pane carries it. `always` is the Measures/Utilities pair, which React mounts unconditionally and DISABLES when it has no body (`toggleDisabled={!utilityBar}`, 🪟️Window/🟦️.tsx:403). `withWorldSurface` is the projection pane, portalled only from inside a world host. `withEngagementOrActionPane` is the Actions pane: `engagementVisible = !!(engagement || actionPane)` (:205), where `engagement` is `undefined` unless the payload carries an option, a control, a controls row or a status line (`windowEngagementToSpec`'s `hasContent`, 🛠️ShellHelpers/🟦️.tsx:1852) and `actionPane` is `undefined` for a kind with no panel-eligible action (`windowActionPaneNode`, :4260). `withSearchSpec` is the Search pane: `search && searchVisible` (:401), and `windowEngagementToSearchSpec` answers `undefined` unless the payload carries an input or at least one possible (:1874). A chip with no body behind it is NOT mounted-and-disabled for these two — React renders no `Pane` at all.
$comment: 🪟️ The per-pane overlay rows React paints inside every window body. `controlId` is React's OWN id — both renderers mint one spelling, `{windowSegment}` being `elementIdSegment(windowId)`, and the footer composition that is left once the wgpu-only utility rail is gone. Geometry source: React's `Pane` (🖱️ui/🎯️targets/⚛️react/🟦️.tsx:9922) positioned by `anchorPositionStyle` (:6864) — a corner anchor insets `--spacing-single` on BOTH its edges, a middle anchor centres on that axis; mount source: 🪟️Window/🟦️.tsx:320-412 plus the world projection pane portalled through `usePaneSlot` (🌐️World3dHost/🟦️.tsx:5210). Measured on the React reference at 1440×900 for the puzzle3d two-pane split (📓️w3b-chip-text-and-footer-dock.md §5, read off `getBoundingClientRect`): pane top row y=64 `Actions` left / `Search` centred / `Window Options` right, pane bottom row y=710 `Utilities` left / `Projection` right.

paneFolds.$comment: 🎛️ What ONE chip press does to the pane, read off React's mounted state: Actions and Search own distinct panes and every chip changes only its own fold. No chip closes another pane, and none opens or closes a surface. Measured on the React reference over ten runs: `pane-chip-utilitybar-unfold` removes no surface and `pane-chip-projection-toggle` moves nothing at all (🗑️generated/parity-run-{1..12}/steps.json, 📓️w12d-pane-chip-ids-and-projection-toggle.md §5).

utilityRailCensus.$comment: 🧰️ What unfolding the `Utilities` chip publishes, measured on the React reference (🗑️generated/parity-run-12/steps.json step `pane-chip-utilitybar-unfold`, 337 → 355 controls). Of React's 20 added rows, 14 are `data-slot` scaffolding its DOM census counts and no canvas renderer publishes (window-chrome-cap/gap/body-surface, utility-bar-body, ribbon-zone/group/item/row, toggle-group, inline-label ×4); the ones that NAME something are the chip flipping to its fold id, the rail root, and ONE row per enabled utility leaf, each carrying that leaf's framework element id.

windowControls.$comment: 🪪️ React's own window control group (🪟️Window/🟦️.tsx:276) — `external`, `maximize` and `close`, each rendered only when its callback is handed in. `ModeWindowDescriptor` OMITS all three (🎨️Canvas/🟦️.tsx:75) and the OS shell passes none, keeping focus and close on the dock TAB, so in this product the group carries NOTHING and is not published at all. It used to be minted unconditionally from `showControls`, which put an empty 2px-wide box carrying `framework.window.{windowSegment}.windowControls` in every DOM census (measured `rect: [524, 65, 2, 16]`, 🗑️generated/w11a-parity-run-14/steps.json step `pane-chip-windowcontrols`) while adding no control and no action.

paneAnchorInsets.$comment: 🧭️ anchorPositionStyle's edges per anchor — `middle` centres on that axis. Both renderers resolve the inset distance from the same --spacing-single / PANEL_INSET_UI_SPACING token.

footerComposition.$comment: 🔚️ React's footerItems (🏛️ShellHost/🟦️.tsx:10613-10635): bottom-left bar, centred bottom-middle bar, a fill, the presence pill, bottom-right bar. No utility rail and no framework.sync.* toggles — React hands buildFrameworkSyncUtilities' three leaves to the bottom-left `s-sync-status` tab's SyncAttachCard (:9076) instead.
footerComposition.$orderComment: 🔚️ Left to right, measured on the React reference at vw 1024 (📓️w3b §3): Display x3 · Remote: detached (#s-sync-status) x78 | Tool x439 · Command x497 (centred on 512) | No one else is here (#s-presence-peers) x660 | Settings x764 · Marketplace x845 · History x946 (ends at vw−3). #s-checkin is NOT footer chrome on either renderer — React renders it inside the History panel's own tree (framework.history.checkin, 🏛️ShellHost/🟦️.tsx:9016), gated by canCheckIn(role).
